operations.title: Gradient Descent on a 3D Loss Surface
operations.caption: From (3, 2), each step moves opposite the gradient: (x, y) ← (x, y) − η ∇f. The path rolls down the bowl toward the minimum at the origin, its shadow tracing the descent on the floor.
operations.narration: Gradient descent walks down a loss surface. Starting at (3, 2), each step moves opposite the gradient, scaled by the learning rate eta. The path rolls down the bowl, and the shadow on the floor shows the descent in the parameter plane, converging toward the minimum at the origin.
